:tep_for:  = FOR / AYE
:tep_against:  = AGAINST / NAY
:tep_abstain:  = TEP ABSTAINS
:tep_present:  = NO OPINION / PRESENT

Noting myself as For. I don't like Quebec's continuing crimes against English punctuation and I have to wonder why a proposal for Onder of all people isn't a condemn, but it's nicely written and it's refreshing to see an old-school genuine high-falutin' deserving nominee instead of Commend Europeian Who Held a Government Position no. 300
Commend Cretox who held a government position
Exqueeze me, I held *multiple* government positions
I also passed some resolutions and wrote some issues, which earned me enough valuable GPoints on the big board to win a prize
To this day I still have no idea if Vara even looked at the commend before it passed
Changed the channel name: [AT VOTE] SC - Commend Onderkelkia
Commend Onderkelkia was passed 8,312 votes to 2,132 (79.6% support).
Changed the channel name: [Concluded] SC - Commend Onderkelkia
